APARTAMENT 2+1+2 PER SHITJE NE KINOSTUDIO
Shitet apartament 2+1+2
Ne zonen e Kinostudios ofrojme apartament per shitje te tipologjise 2+1+2
Apartamenti ka nje siperfaqe prej 102m2 bruto dhe 91 m2 neto.
Eshte i organizuar ne nje korridor i cili bene shperndarjen ne nje sallon te bollshem se bashku me ambjentin e gatimit, dy dhome gjumi , dy tualete dhe nje ballkon.
Apartamenti ndodhet kati 5.
Shitet i mobiluar.
Disponon certefikate pronesie.
Bashke me apartamentin disponojme edhe garazh me cmim ekstra.
Per me shume detaje apo nje vizite ne prone me kontaktoni.
description_en: 2+1+2 APARTMENT FOR SALE IN KINOSTUDIO 2+1+2 apartment for sale In the Kinostudio area, we offer an apartment for sale of the typology 2+1+2. The apartment has an area of ​​102 m2 gross and 91 m2 net. It is organized in a corridor which divides into a spacious living room together with the kitchen area, two bedrooms, two bathrooms and a balcony. The apartment is located on the 5th floor. It is sold furnished. It has ownership certificates. Along with the apartment, we also have a garage at an extra cost. For more details or a visit to the property, contact me.
